card.name: Words leading into killing wildlife or fish
card.fires_on: Words just before or inside a term for poison, traps, or lethal methods used on animals, in nature or wildlife news. Often a small word like "typically", "called" or "a" ahead of a pesticide or fishing gear name.

modes.label: Inside poison words
modes.description: Partway through the word poison, or in baited-vaccine words, in animal-control text.

modes.label: Lead-in to lethal gear or agents
modes.description: A linking word or adjective right before a pesticide, trap, or destructive fishing method.
modes.example: they sprayed the pond with a pesticide<< called>> Rotenone.

modes.label: Harm to animals from human activity
modes.description: Words describing efficient or damaging fishing and mines that kill or injure.
modes.example: to today’s vastly more<< destructive>> "hookah" diving.

card.writes: It nudges toward words about loss and preservation, and away from words about flying or splitting.
card.plain: It lights up on small words just before text names a poison, trap or other way animals get killed.
